planning_premise.rule: Do not create a second mobile shell/app merely because the swarm surface is named Prometeo móvil. Treat mobile as a context/viewport/interaction dimension of the single served Universal Host unless later authoritative evidence explicitly establishes another product identity.

input_status.rule: This draft may establish sequencing and invariants now, but later local integration must reload and disposition the exact durable returns rather than treating this plan as their substitute.

north_star: A human on a phone can correct or request work once inside the existing Prometeo host, disposable identical workers can perform distinct scoped work without manual routing, a local steward reconciles results, and the verified outcome returns to the same host/page thread without creating another navigation or authority system.

campaign_stages.completion_rule: Exact durable RETURN exists for every dependency required by O-SURFACE-PROMETEO_MOBILE-LOCAL-INTEGRATE-V1.
campaign_stages.planner_action: Harvest returns incrementally. Do not wait to learn, but do not synthesize absent evidence as fact.

actions: Compile intent + UX + risk + reuse + discovery into a mobile-context campaign against the single Universal Host.
Use the durable Surface Registry owner for surface_id/route metadata; do not create a second local registry.
Represent missing mobile-specific identity as unresolved rather than inventing a catalog page_id.
Convert only concrete gaps into scoped worker opportunities with explicit acceptance tests.
campaign_stages.output: surface-scoped micro-DAG consumed by the local Steward/integration lane

worker_pattern: CONTEXT_COMPILE: derive the smallest reopenable working set for the page/change request.
EXECUTE: make the smallest preserve-first isolated change allowed by the work item.
VERIFY: independently exercise the requested behavior and protected regressions.
CRITIQUE when risk/novelty/authority warrants a fresh evaluator.
LOCAL STEWARD: disposition immutable returns and emit one integration candidate.

protected_behavior: safe-area, resize, rotation and VisualViewport anchor recomputation
semantic-corner persistence rather than pixel persistence
closed puck repeatable drag and re-grab behavior
Favorites identity/order remains owned by existing shell authority
Change Loop controls remain readable independent of child-page palette
canonical completion link remains inside the Universal Host
private Capture payloads never enter public coordination
falsification_examples: rotation or VisualViewport change leaves the control off-screen or under a mobile safe area
a page-scoped correction causes a second global puck/shell to mount
HACER returns a raw child URL instead of the host-routed page/change result
moving the puck interrupts active recording/transcription
opening a result marks unrelated or merely-synced work as seen
worker progress shown in UI cannot be reconstructed from durable claim/run/return evidence
campaign_stages.test_reuse_rule: Consume existing Universal Shell/P4 browser and parity tests first; add new tests only for uncovered concrete mobile regressions found by intent/UX/risk returns or real product use.

actions: Preserve contradictions instead of majority-voting them away.
Emit a local integration candidate and exact verification set.
Delegate cross-root/global-authority conflicts upward; keep routine mobile reconciliation local.

campaign_stages.success_path: human correction in page thread -> planned micro-swarm -> durable returns -> local steward -> verified candidate/result -> same Universal Host/page thread
campaign_stages.human_burden_target: one correction/request plus optional acceptance judgment; no prompt/result courier work

dynamic_worker_allocation.EXECUTE: Only for a concrete scoped change with known owner/target and acceptance tests.
dynamic_worker_allocation.DISCOVER: Find non-duplicate mobile-context gaps from actual returns, incidents or product feedback.
dynamic_worker_allocation.PLAN_LOCAL: Recompile the surface micro-DAG when new durable returns materially change sequencing.
dynamic_worker_allocation.CRITIQUE: Use a fresh worker for high-risk shell/navigation/privacy/authority changes or conflicting evidence.
dynamic_worker_allocation.VERIFY: Prefer independence from the generator; reconstruct behavior from tests/receipts rather than prose.
dynamic_worker_allocation.INTEGRATE_LOCAL: Only after dependency evidence satisfies the canonical local-integration activation rule.
dynamic_worker_allocation.CONTEXT_COMPILE: Supply role/task-specific context without raw transcript dumps.
dynamic_worker_allocation.RECOVER: Only under stale/retry policy; never overwrite the original attempt.
dynamic_worker_allocation.COMPACT: Distill durable surface state after material campaign changes without changing product authority.

authority_and_privacy_boundaries: This campaign is not Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.
Universal Shell V5 remains the single global host authority; no mobile fork is inferred.
Surface Registry owns shared surface route metadata once available; this plan must consume it.
Capture private audio/files/transcripts stay in the private backend.
Worker/Control Room UI is a derived projection, not task or product authority.
A candidate touching served V5 must pass existing promotion/byte verification gates; this plan does not self-promote it.

non_obvious_findings.finding: The durable truth currently supports Prometeo móvil as a logical work surface over the served root host, so the highest-value local plan is context-sensitive verification/improvement of one host, not a parallel mobile product lineage.

The requested correction-to-result loop already has a software-complete served substrate: page Change Threads, HACER/Pensar preparation, disposable workers, durable execution polling and host-routed results. The planner should generate delta work only where real mobile evidence falsifies that loop.

A dependency-aware local planner artifact can be useful before all sibling returns exist if it explicitly labels those returns unresolved and defers integration. This allows parallel planning without turning absence into fabricated evidence.

deduplication.reason: Before intent/UX/reuse/risk/discovery returns land, proposing concrete new mobile build tasks would guess at gaps already being independently investigated. The canonical local-integration lane already owns fan-in and next-wave generation.
